[1/6] Plan player-visible faction economy, hyperlane trade links severed by war, and slow faction/world technology drift that raises carrying capacity.

impact_assessment.why: Faction economy is visible but opaque, trade income is an abstract formula with no partners, and world tech levels never change, so the demographic model is static.
impact_assessment.benefits: Players can read where a faction's money comes from and goes, peaceful neighbours profit from real trade, war cuts those links, and long games see technology raise population ceilings.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: GameState/FactionEconomy schema additions; dependency: stdlib only; concurrency: tick ordering between trade, economy and population; state: derived trade links must round-trip
impact_assessment.mitigation: Backward-compatible defaults, deterministic formulas, focused unit tests, UI task with vision review, full gates
